description: Aligning the export reader drops correction-tensor preservation for old-name-only input.
trigger: Load an Ernie sparse layer whose file map contains `<mlp>.moe_statics.e_score_correction_bias` but not `<mlp>.gate.e_score_correction_bias`, then collect the layer tensors for export.
expected_behavior: If preserving optional source metadata across conversion, read the original tensor and emit it under the canonical `gate` name.
actual_behavior: The exact optional lookup returns `None`, so the exporter omits the tensor. The path is reached through the block's recursive load and conversion's module iteration; the standard router ignores the field, so this does not demonstrate a generation regression.

verification.description: Modeled exact-key resolution against old-only and exported-only dictionaries, including precedence of the in-memory overlay.
verification.limits: No actual checkpoint load or conversion. The trigger requires absence of the new name from the complete source map, not merely one sampled shard.

introductions.rationale: This commit changes the optional correction-bias suffix from moe_statics to gate, with an exact lookup.
